style: Say gently and expressively, like a grandmother reading a picture book aloud
lines: Help the pig build a house. Pick the walls and the roof, then test them with the wolf, the rain, a peek and a cold night.
What do you think will happen? Predict first!
Little pig, little pig, let me come in!
Not by the hair of my chinny chin chin!
Then I'll huff,
and I'll puff!
Huff... puff... phew!
Hi there!
Is that... a shadow?
